newsitem.title: POLAND: PLI sets issue price at PLN 6 - 9.
newsitem.headline: PLI sets issue price at PLN 6 - 9.

text.p: Polish wholesale and retail trader Polish Life Improvement SA (PLI) set the issue price of its new issue of between one million and 3.5 million shares at between six and nine zlotys, PLI said in a statement on Monday.
It said the issue had yet to be approved by the extraordinary shareholders' meeting on December 6.
It also said the issue, ex rights, would be directed to selected institutional long-term investors.
PLI, which is listed on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, currently has 7,051,213 shares outstanding.
